method: Risk index = (H·E·V)^⅓ (our geometric mean; factors from the IPCC climate-risk framework)

inputs.hazard: H = P × T × M. P: ESA CCI permafrost fraction. T: ERA5-Land 1–2.89 m soil 3.9 °C → 1 (-5 °C = 0, -1 °C = 1). M: trend pending; NISAR 2026 thaw-shaped seasonal sinking (r² ≥ 0.3), 5 cm = 1, as a ground-ice indicator
inputs.vulnerability: 0.6 (IPCC: susceptibility 0.6 and coping capacity 0.4, researched estimates)
